name: EIWZ Christmas Bash 1998

date.source: The broadcast's own title, "Christmas Bash 1998"; no exact day survives on the served results page.

appearances.note: Ran in during the North American Title match to hit Jazz with his own finisher, Pumped Up.
Ran in on the European Title tournament final to hit Pain with her own finisher, the Split-Leg Moonsault.
Ringside interference across three separate matches on the card.
Ran in on the North American Title match, setting up Flint for a Spinebuster before the referee's own disqualification call.
Pulled Jazzmine off the ring apron during the North American Title match, knocking her out against the safety rail.

notes: All five of the fed's own titles changed or were crowned on this card: the Extreme, North American, European, Light Weight, and Tag Team Championships. Structured this pass into twenty individual matches — an opening tag match, a singles match, a Light Weight Royal Rumble, a fourteen-bout European Title tournament (seven first-round bouts, four second-round, two semifinals, one final), a North American Title match, a Tag Team Title scramble, and a ten-man Extreme Title Royal Rumble main event.

matches.note: Pain fought both men alone; Flint and Pump Daddy each hit their own finisher (a double superplex followed by the Flint Bomb and the Pumped Up) for the win.
Jazzmine walked to ringside, distracting Keeper; Jazz then hit him with a chair for the pin.

eliminations.note: thrown out attempting a second top-rope dropkick
eliminated together with Spyder by one clothesline
billed as revenge for his own elimination

matches.note: The card's own text states the field was "down to 5" partway through, a count the named eliminations alone don't fully reconcile — an honest inconsistency in the source, not corrected here. The Creep's own fate in the Rumble is never stated; he is named among the entrants but never among the eliminated or the finalists.
Pump Daddy won by pinfall after hitting the Pumped Up.
Annihilator won by disqualification after Rey Mysterio used a chair.
Shaggy 2 Dope won by pinfall after hitting the X-Plosive.
Triple X won by pinfall after distracting the referee himself while his own manager, Bambie, hit Dirty Don Flamingo with a brick from her purse.
Havok won by pinfall after hitting the Spinbuster. Billed on the card only by the shorthand "XXX" — Xavier X. Xanadu's own initials, not Triple X, who fought a separate bout on the same card.
The Keeper won by countout after Fatty Magee walked away five minutes into the match.
Necromancer won by pinfall after hitting the Conjured.
Pain won by pinfall after hitting the Absolute Pain.
Annihilator won by pinfall after hitting the Fallout.
Havok won by countout after hitting the Spinebuster outside the ring.
Necromancer won by pinfall after The Keeper laid down and allowed the pin.
Pain won after putting Annihilator through the Absolute Pain.
Havok won by pinfall after hitting the Spinebuster.

Jazz and Jazzmine ran in; Jazzmine distracted the referee while Jazz hit Pain with her own finisher, the Split-Leg Moonsault, before Havok hit the Spinebuster for the pin and the EIWZ European Championship. See this wing's own reigns ledger (eiwz-european-r001).

EIWZ North American Championship. Flint won by disqualification. Jazzmine distracted the referee before Zuel pulled her off the apron, knocking her out against the safety rail; Pump Daddy then ran in and hit Jazz with the Pumped Up, and Havok ran in and set up Flint for the Spinebuster, which the referee saw just as it landed. The source's own text does not fully resolve whose interference the disqualification itself was called against. See this wing's own reigns ledger (eiwz-north-american-r001).

EIWZ Tag Team Championship. A scramble whose own field beyond the final two is never named; after twenty minutes, SCSU Pimpster threw Triple X into the front row for the win, the titles awarded to Pimpster and his own tag partner, Cool Moe "D." See this wing's own reigns ledger (eiwz-tag-team-r001).

eliminations.note: clotheslined, then hit with the Absolute Pain

matches.note: EIWZ Extreme Championship, main event. Ten men are named as remaining after ten minutes had already elapsed; the field's own earlier eliminations, if any, are not stated. See this wing's own reigns ledger (eiwz-extreme-r001).

name: EIWZ Wednesday Night Extreme (December 17, 1998)

date.source: The fed's own served results page's own dateline, "Thursday December 17" — five days after Christmas Bash 1998, consistent with the fed's own paired card-preview page dating the same broadcast "Wednesday December 16, 1998."

appearances.note: Announced his own in-fiction retirement mid-show, introducing a masked replacement, Psycho.
Announced his own in-fiction retirement mid-show, introducing a masked replacement, Damian.

notes: Three title defenses (Necromancer over The Creep, Light Weight; Havok over Annihilator, European; Pain over Jazz, Extreme) and one title change (Triple X over Flint, North American), plus a tag scaffold match (Creep/Pain over MoD), two non-title singles matches (Pump Daddy over Violent J; Johnny Rocquet over Fatty Magee by disqualification), and a no-contest (Mandriller/Dirty Don Flamingo). Flint and Pump Daddy announce their own retirement mid-show, introducing two masked replacements, Damian and Psycho.

matches.note: EIWZ Light Weight Championship. Necromancer retained by pinfall after Creep missed the Creep Crash and Necromancer hit the Conjured.
Pump Daddy won by pinfall after reversing a suplex attempt into the Pumped Up.
EIWZ European Championship. Havok retained by pinfall after hitting the Spinebuster.

Creep and Pain won; both wore rain coats in anticipation of a run-in mob ("20 men led by billy the terd") throwing dog crap into the ring, then Creep scored the pin. The mob and its own named leader are a one-off comic beat the source never returns to and are recorded here in prose only, not minted as entities.
EIWZ North American Championship. Triple X won by pinfall after reversing the Flint Bomb into the X-Rated. See this wing's own reigns ledger (eiwz-north-american-r002).

Johnny Rocquet won by disqualification after Flint and Pump Daddy came out and each hit Rocquet with their own finisher. Flint then announced that he and Pump Daddy were both retiring, introducing two masked replacements: Damian (6'6", 327 lbs) for himself, and Psycho (6'8", 354 lbs) for Pump Daddy.
Dirty Don Flamingo announced his own retirement in place of wrestling; Mandriller never reached the ring.
EIWZ Extreme Championship, main event. Pain retained by pinfall after a superplex into the Absolute Pain.
